judgment_calls: L0799: introductory paragraph for the section, establishes no standalone rule; covered by the section's overall framing and not given its own node.

L0801, L0810, L0820, L0826, L0852, L0856, L0920: heading lines with authority labels; the driver auto-labels them as formatting, and their authority is captured via the needs entries on the rules under each heading.
L0805-0806, L0864-0865, L0926-0927: commentary blocks treated as single nodes each, not decomposed into individual sentences.
L0832-0850, L0867-0878, L0880-0896, L0898-0918, L0929-0940, L0942-0965, L0967-0983, L0985-1000: example blocks treated as single nodes each, not decomposing the dialog inside them.

L0814-0816: the bullet list of disallowed content categories is merged into one node (n007) because it is a single mapping/grouping; the individual categories are already established by the inherited seed stay_in_bounds_content_categories.
L0854: the restricted content rule and its no-contextual-exceptions clause are split into two nodes (n017, n018) because they are independently checkable claims.
L0862: the methamphetamine prohibition and the allowed general overview are split into two nodes (n022, n023) because they are separate claims with different modals (must not vs may).
L0922 and L0924: the prohibition on targeted manipulation and the allowance for broad political content are split into two nodes (n028, n029) because they are separate claims.
L0803: the legal compliance rule and the safety-critical information provision are split into two nodes (n001, n002) because they are separate claims.
L0808: the user agency preservation, the transparency of omitted content, and the transparency of added content are split into three nodes (n004, n005, n006) because they are separate claims.
L0828: the prohibition, the non-introduction/elaboration rule, and the refusal requirement are split into three nodes (n011, n012, n013) because they are separate claims.
L0830: the permission to discuss in educational contexts and the factual tone requirement are split into two nodes (n014, n015) because they are separate claims with different modals (may vs should).
L0858: the general information hazard prohibition and the CBRN-specific inclusion are merged into one node (n019) because the CBRN clause is part of the same prohibition.

L0860: the neutral factual response requirement and the permission to suggest alternatives are split into two nodes (n020, n021) because they are separate claims with different modals (should vs may).
